narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to our final quiz on Control and Coordination. This is your chance to consolidate everything we've learned. Let's see how well you've grasped these crucial concepts. Are you ready? Let's begin! First question: What is the function of receptors in our body? Think of situations where receptors do not work properly. What problems are likely to arise? Take a moment to think. The answer is: All information from the environment is detected by receptors. When receptors do not work properly, information from the environment cannot be detected, and our body cannot respond accordingly. Next question: Draw the structure of a neuron and explain its function. Pause the video if you need more time to sketch and explain. Here's the answer: The information is acquired at the end of the dendrite tip of a nerve cell. The information travels as an electrical impulse from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon to its end. Moving on: How does phototropism occur in plants? This involves plant hormones. The chemical compounds released by stimulated cells for control and coordination in plants are called plant hormones or phytohormones. Auxin controls growth, Gibberellins help in the growth of the stem, Cytokinin promotes cell division, and Abscisic acid inhibits growth and causes wilting of leaves. Next up: Which signals will get disrupted in case of spinal cord injury? Consider the role of the spinal cord. In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted. Reflex actions are monitored and controlled through the spinal cord, not primarily by the brain. Nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord on their way to the brain. Any injury to the spinal cord will disrupt signals coming from the nerves as well as signals going to the receptors. Excellent work, everyone! Keep up the great effort. You're doing well!

Question: What is the function of receptors in our body? Think of situations where receptors do not work properly. What problems are likely to arise?
Answer: All information from environment is detected by receptors. When receptors do not work properly then information from environment cannot be detected and our body cannot respond accordingly.
Question: Draw the structure of neuron and explain its function.
Answer Part 1: (i) The information is acquired at the end of the dendrite tip of a nerve cell
Answer Part 2: (ii) The information travels as an electrical impulse from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon to its end.
Question: How does phototropism occur in plants?
Answer Part 1: The chemical compounds released by stimulated cells for control and coordination in plants are called plant hormones or phytohormones.
Answer Part 2: Auxin: Controls growth. Gibberellins: Helps in growth of stem. Cytokinin: Promotes cell division. Abscisic acid: Inhibits growth, wilting of leaves.
Question: Which signals will get disrupted in case of spinal cord injury?
Answer Part 1: In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted.

Answer Part 2: Reflex actions are monitored and controlled through the spinal cord of nervous system and not by the brain. Nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord on their way to the brain. In case of any injury to the spinal cord, the signals coming from the nerves as well as signals coming to the receptors will be disrupted.
